smoke.notes: Full-frame rolling smoke/fog, fairly generic but clean bg

particles.notes: Golden bokeh particles — primary choice for divine/sacred scenes
Warm ember/rising particles — slow drift, good for penance/longing scenes

god_rays.file: God-rays/God-ray with visible dust in beam.mp4
god_rays.notes: God-ray with visible dust in beam — primary choice, richer than the vertical shaft variant
Simpler single beam — backup/variant to avoid repetition across scenes

rain.notes: Subtle mist/rain — use only for mood-tagged scenes (grief, penance, longing)

grain.notes: Mid-gray noise texture, 1920x1080 native — applied globally to every scene, not mood-conditional. Uses grainmerge blend, NOT screen (screen would wash out a mid-gray texture).
